one_line_input.description: The raw description of the business/brand this foundation was built from.

positioning.description: One or two sentences: what this brand is, for whom, and why it's different from the obvious alternative. Not a mission statement — a competitive stance.

audience.description: Who this is actually for, specific enough to picture one real person, not a demographic bucket.

tone.description: How the brand sounds and feels across every asset — the voice, not just adjectives. What it never sounds like matters as much as what it does.

visual_pillars.description: 3-6 concrete, checkable visual rules every asset should follow (palette direction, type feel, photography vs illustration, composition habits). Specific enough that a stranger could self-audit an asset against them.

avoid.description: Visual or tonal cliches this brand explicitly refuses to look/sound like. The competitive fence, not just a style note.
